title: Coefficient estimates and Bohr phenomenon for pluriharmonic mappings in the polydisc
summary: We introduce the class $\mathscr{P}_{\mathcal{H}_n^0}(α)$ $(0\leq α<1)$ of normalized pluriharmonic mappings in the setting of several complex variables. This class extends the harmonic family $\mathscr{P}_{\mathcal{H}}^{0}(α)$ to the multidimensional framework. We establish sharp coefficient estimates and growth theorems for functions in $\mathscr{P}_{\mathcal{H}_n^0}(α)$, thereby generalizing the corresponding results of Li and Ponnusamy \cite{Li-Ponnusamy-2013a} and Allu and Halder \cite{Allu-Halder-2021}.
